# Generative Loaders snapshot

`generative-loaders-0.1.2.tgz` is built from the official
`kasturikhanke/generative-loaders` repository at commit
`dae0e7faa93f29424bfddab703bd9cd4e891e7b0`.

The snapshot is used because the `halo` InlineLoader variant is available in
the official 0.1.2 source but that version is not yet published to npm. The
package tarball includes its MIT license and upstream distribution files.
